scope: Read-only transport diagnosis of two failed census cases; six observed requests within nine quote GETs including warmup/background reads
transport: HTTP/3, reused connection for all six sampled requests
limitations: Repeated same-amount DOM timings are instrumentation-invalid: the replay timer rejected compatible pre-existing React Query quotes and waited for a background refetch. They do not establish new product failures.
Cross-origin ResourceTiming DNS/connect/TLS/request/header fields were hidden without Timing-Allow-Origin; CDP fields were used. DNS/connect/TLS were not repeated on reused connections.
No server timing or matching origin request telemetry was captured, so edge/network and origin work cannot be separated.
Original 1110.9/1101.2 ms live census failures remain FAIL; these limited replay transports did not reproduce their ~1 second fetch delay.
